entries.0c2370f3711cae5d: This business manufactures and sells noncombustible building materials for housing, non-housing and buildings, including ceramic siding, soffits, gable boards and fireproof panels for housing and non-housing use. Revenue from external customers was ¥15,356 million in the fiscal year ended April 2026, accounting for more than half of total revenue. Products are manufactured at the Takuma Plant and the Ishioka Plant. The company is in charge of this.

entries.1492dbf270b6ffb1: The Building Materials Business accounts for a majority of revenue, and the structure is such that trends in the housing market determine performance. entries.df732f27b26d6392: It has announced a 3-year medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years from the fiscal year ended April 2026 to the fiscal year ending April 2028, and its basic policies include building a sustainable growth model by addressing social issues such as environmental measures in a way that balances this with social contribution, and taking steps toward management that is conscious of the cost of capital. As its activities, it cites: active rollout of products that capture and use exhaust gas CO2 toward achieving zero CO2 emissions by 2030; expansion of CO2 recycling technology into a wide range of fields; creation of demand in high-end markets using the originality of core technologies typified by ceramics; and productivity improvement and labor saving through AI-centered ICT technologies and deeper KIP activities.
